changed: `splitCcEcdCountedLine` splits a Caller's Companion English line only when the line starts with a count or bar range (after an optional section label, `A1&A2` included), and not before a bracketed number followed by what it counts (steps, doubles, dancers, people, `and a half`). `ecdStatedCountPattern` (formerly private, now `@visibleForTesting`) and the section-label prefix of the bar-range pattern no longer backtrack quadratically on a long run of spaces.
